id: title:cvolzer3:split connected servers into a gateway left rail

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a frontend-only sidebar rail and search capability for managing Gateway servers, alongside backend changes to the server list metadata and sorting. This could help PostHog users discover and filter their connected Gateway servers, but the lack of backend implementation and shared state changes makes the full benefit and compatibility unverified.
review.reason: Adds a new sidebar rail component, GatewayRail, with navigation buttons, and a GatewayServersSearch component for filtering. P1.F2.H5 removes the connected server count button and category filter. P1.F8.H4 removes the CONNECTED_SERVERS_FILTER constant and its usage, while renaming connectedServerCount to connectedServers, changing its return type from number to GatewayServerEntry[]
review.uncertainty: This chunk is frontend-only; no backend, API, or shared state changes are supplied. The connection to PostHog's actual MCP store implementation and whether this change survives backend compatibility is unverified. The tier is assigned based on the observed frontend and backend metadata changes, but the complete implementation and compatibility are not demonstrated.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the complete implementation of the removed search and category-filter buttons, nor the complete implementation of the GatewayRail component, nor the complete implementation of the GatewayServersSearch component. The chunk also does not include the complete implementation of the GatewayTeamAndAgents, GatewayTeamSettings, and GatewayAuditLog components. As

observations.behavior: Adds a new sidebar rail component, GatewayRail, which displays a list of connected MCP servers and their status. It also adds a set of navigation buttons for managing servers, team, and settings.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a UI component for displaying and managing MCP server connections, including a sidebar rail and navigation buttons.

observations.behavior: Removes the connected server count button and the category filter button from the GatewayServersHome component.
observations.posthog_connection: Removes the connected server count button and the category filter button from the GatewayServersHome component.

observations.behavior: Adds a GatewayServersSearch component, which provides a search input for filtering MCP servers.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a search input for filtering MCP servers.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a frontend-only change. No backend, API, or shared state changes are supplied, so the connection to PostHog's actual MCP store implementation and whether this change survives backend compatibility is unverified. No tier assignment.

observations.behavior: Removed the constant CONNECTED_SERVERS_FILTER and its usage; removed the connectedServerCount property and its implementation; renamed connectedServerCount to connectedServers and changed its return type from number to GatewayServerEntry[]; added alphabetical sorting to the connectedServers implementation; removed the CONNECTED_SERVERS_FILTER-based exclusion from the filtered list.
observations.posthog_connection: This could change the gateway's server list and its metadata exposed to the MCP store frontend, potentially affecting how connected servers are displayed or consumed by the MCP store UI.
